deadline.value: University fellowship consideration needs complete applications by December 15, 2026; departmental assistantship consideration runs to January 15, 2027.
deadline.quote: To be considered for all university fellowships, complete applications should be received by December 15 | To receive full consideration for departmental support via graduate teaching or research assistantships, all application materials should be received by January 15

gre_subject.value: The Physics GRE is not required, but a score can be sent to support the application.
gre_subject.quote: We do not require the Physics GRE (PGRE) exam. | However, you may submit a PGRE score if you feel it can support your application

supervisor.value: No supervisor contact is needed, and admission decisions are made by the graduate admissions committee.
supervisor.quote: No, you are not required to contact a potential supervisor. | admission decisions are made by the graduate admissions committee

funding.value: Continuous support is usually available to PhD students in good standing through teaching assistantships, research assistantships or fellowships.
funding.quote: Continuous financial support is usually available for PhD students in good academic standing either through teaching assistantships, research assistantships, or fellowships

entry_route.value: Almost all applicants go straight into the PhD after a BS or equivalent degree.
entry_route.quote: Almost all of our prospective students directly enter the Ph.D. program after earning their BS or equivalent degree

gre_general.value: The department does not require the general GRE, but a score can be sent to support the application.
gre_general.quote: We do not require the GRE exam. | However, you may submit a GRE score if you feel it can support your application

notes: Astronomy is a specialization of this PhD ("MS/PhD in Physics with a specialization in Astronomy"), so astronomy is listed in also_fields. The Tri-Campus Materials Science PhD is a separate program. The graduate school, not the department, sets the application fee and does not waive it except in narrow cases.
